entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to make a return? I'm a bit confused about how it all works. I ordered a helmet and it just arrived.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, I don't think it's broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked so different on my computer screen. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I see. So the issue is just with the color, not the fit or any of the safety features. Is that correct?
Yes, exactly. I just want to make sure I have gear I'm happy with, you know? It's a safety item, after all. I'm just so overwhelmed with the website and policies. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I completely understand. Wanting the right color for your new helmet is perfectly reasonable. Since you received it just six days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
Oh, really? It's that easy? Thank you! I was so worried it would be a problem since the box is unopened and I wasn't sure if that was allowed.

Not a problem at all. Keeping it in the original packaging is perfect. I'm processing the return for you now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label in just a moment. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
